name: Amp Megawatt

meters.label: Included agent usage
meters.hint: ampcode.com/settings, or run amp usage in the CLI.

reset.rule: Resets at the end of each monthly billing period.
stipulations: Models are charged at the provider's API price with no markup.
Web search and other tools also spend usage.
The first message after switching models costs more, because prompt caches are per model.
Use through a linked ChatGPT or Claude subscription, or your own key, doesn't count.

reset.rule: Resets at the end of each monthly billing period.
stipulations: Billed per minute by orb size. A paused orb costs nothing.
An orb pauses 5 minutes after the agent stops or 20 minutes after your last message, whichever is later.
Self-hosted orbs and runners are free and don't count.

overage: At the limit, add paid credits, link a ChatGPT or Claude subscription, or upgrade. Purchased credits last 12 months. Amp doesn't publish a per-credit price or an auto-reload option.

how: $20 a month for Amp credits on any model plus 45,000 minutes of hosted orbs.
Amp doesn't publish the dollar amount of included agent usage.
ext: Bring your own key on any tier: OpenRouter, Bedrock, Google Cloud, Azure Foundry, Ollama Cloud, OpenCode Go and custom endpoints.
Link a ChatGPT subscription for OpenAI models or a Claude subscription for Claude models. Amp doesn't bill that use.
Runs as a CLI and as desktop and mobile apps.
quirks: Megawatt includes $20 of agent usage (third-party report, unconfirmed).
The free Hobby plan has every feature if you bring your own keys or subscriptions. Megawatt pays for Amp-hosted models and orbs.
Megawatt 50 ($50, 2.5x the usage) shows only after you sign in.
Since 12 Nov 2026 a model selector replaced the Dial. Old Dial settings didn't carry over.
